components.name: Button
components.summary: A button that does something, in four styles.

components.name: SidebarItem
components.summary: One row in a sidebar: a link to a page, a button that does something, or a heading.

components.name: SidebarAccount
components.summary: The account row at the foot of the sidebar, and the menu it opens.

components.name: AppSwitcher
components.summary: The sidebar head as a button: the current app's mark and name, and an up-down caret.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The app's navigation, always a sidebar.

components.name: Focus
components.summary: Keyboard focus, the same on every component, as on claude.ai: one blue ring and one soft glow.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The top of a page: its title, one line about it, and the page's main action on the right.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A short list of actions or places that opens over the page from a button.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short hint shown above an element on hover and keyboard focus.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A small window over the page that asks to confirm an action.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Choosing a task's due date: quick picks, a month, and its reminders, in a popover.

components.name: Search
components.summary: A dialog for finding tasks: the field on top, results grouped below.

components.name: Link
components.summary: A teal, underlined link inside running text.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text fields and text areas, with a label, an optional hint and an error.

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: A text field with an icon inside it, for quick add and search.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Choosing one option from a list, using the browser's own menu.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A square checkbox with its label, and an optional hint under it.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Choosing one of a few options that are all visible at once.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A short round label for a status or a fact on a row.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A message at the top of a page or form: a notice that something worked, or an error.

components.name: StatTile
components.summary: A big number with its label, for counts at a glance (admin overview, jobs).

components.name: DetailList
components.summary: Label and value pairs describing one record (a user, a client, a job).

components.name: Code
components.summary: Machine values: IDs, secrets, error codes and keyboard keys, in the system's monospace.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A white, slightly raised panel that groups one task on a page.

components.name: Table
components.summary: Rows of records, usually inside a card.

components.name: TaskRow
components.summary: One task in a list: checkbox, title, due date.

components.name: TaskPane
components.summary: The open task, beside the list (on wide screens) or in its place (on narrow ones).

components.name: Senin
components.summary: Senin applied to both apps: the todo workspace and the idp Account page, in light and dark.

components.name: SignIn
components.summary: The signed-out page, used for sign in, sign up and password reset.

components.name: ErrorPage
components.summary: A signed-out page that says something went wrong and what to do (idp's "Can't sign in to this app").

components.name: Email
components.summary: The password reset email, in Senin's light colours.
